description: This file defines a REST controller in a Spring Boot application that handles HTTP requests related to assignments within a course in a learning management system. It provides endpoints for listing assignments and creating new assignments, utilizing security and DTOs.

classes.name: AssignmentController
classes.description: REST controller managing assignment-related endpoints for courses, including listing and creating assignments.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all assignments for a specified course. Retrieves user ID from authentication and calls service to fetch assignments.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new assignment within a course. Validates request body, retrieves user ID, and calls service to create an assignment.
